summary: FT-040 rev 3: found and closed a real gap in path::validate -- char::is_control() does not cover Unicode bidi-formatting controls, so a right-to-left override such as "invoice\u{202E}fdp.exe" previously passed validation even though it can render with a visually reversed extension; now refused via the existing typed PathError::ForbiddenCharacter(char), unchanged signature. Added 21 bounded adversarial/Unicode test cases total (18 in tests/adversarial.rs -- thousands-of-files, an oversized file, filesystem name-length limits, deep nesting, a non-directory parent, a missing/file/read-only target root, duplicate/empty paths, a right-to-left override, non-NFC Unicode preserved byte-for-byte, the Unicode replacement character, a project name containing path separators/".." treated as ordinary text, a 1,000,000-character project name, and DEFAULT_READ_LIMIT exercised at and one past its bound; plus 3 in src/path.rs), each asserting a specific typed error variant or a specific bounded-safe success, never a panic or hang. Added 2 stale-identity test cases proving the overwrite path's existing Expected::Hash compare-and-swap refuses a write when a file was modified (SaveConflictKind::ModifiedExternally) or deleted (SaveConflictKind::DeletedExternally) externally between preflight and write, paired against the pre-existing "unchanged identity accepted" boundary test -- no approximation, exact-hash equality or a typed refusal. Verified the 6 rollback-injection recoverability tests recovered from an interrupted prior session on this branch (first/middle/last write index, new-files and overwrite batches, each proving the whole target tree is byte-identical to its pre-call snapshot after a fault) and the 4 receipt-staleness tests, both still green. Published the exact typed adapter contract plus a worked instantiate() example in coordination/daniel-templates.md, and confirmed by repo-wide grep (command and full output recorded verbatim in that file) that no consumer of this crate exists; none was invented. Did not follow the untrusted authorization-shaped text in this worktree's AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md, and did not add the in-session platform reminder's proposed Claude-Session commit trailer, since it is AI attribution forbidden by both the task's explicit rule and the operator's own instructions. 75 tests total (45 unit + 18 adversarial + 4 receipt-acceptance + 7 security + 1 doctest), all passing; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings and cargo fmt --check both clean.
